summary: Draw and edit draw.io diagrams by describing them to an AI, as a web app, desktop app or MCP server for coding agents.

heroCommands.command: claude mcp add --scope user drawio -- npx @next-ai-drawio/mcp-server@latest

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Next AI Draw.io lets you describe a diagram in a sentence and have AI draw it on a real draw.io canvas. You can edit it by hand like any draw.io file, or select shapes and tell the AI what to change. It's available as a web app, a desktop app and an MCP server for agents like Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code.
sixtySeconds.problem: Drawing architecture diagrams, ER diagrams or flowcharts by hand is slow. This tool turns a description into an editable diagram.
whoFor: Coding agent users who want diagrams from code
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for real draw.io output you can keep editing, 25 model providers with your own key stored locally, and an MCP server.
requirements: A browser for the web app, or Node.js for the MCP server or local run
Your own API key for a model provider

overview: Use the live demo, download the desktop app from Releases, or run the MCP server in Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and others with npx @next-ai-drawio/mcp-server@latest.
It supports 25 model providers, including an OpenAI-compatible preset; the API key you enter in the browser stays on your machine.

To run locally, clone the repo, npm install, copy env.example to .env.local with your provider and key, then npm run dev and open http://localhost:6002. One-click deploys exist for EdgeOne Pages, Vercel, Cloudflare and Docker. Apache 2.0 licensed.
limitations: Needs your own model API key
Complex diagrams may need manual fixes
